newsitem.title: BELGIUM: European car makers correct sales rise upwards.
newsitem.headline: European car makers correct sales rise upwards.

text.p: The European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA) on Tuesday said West European car registrations rose by 8.5 percent in December from December 1995 and not by 6.5 percent as announced earlier.
In the January-December period new registrations were up by 6.6 percent instead of the 6.5 percent announced earlier, according to provisional figures.
ACEA said a mistake had been made in calculations by official German government sources.
